description: This Java class represents a data structure for handling savings approval information, including approval date, locale, date format, and row index. It provides an immutable object with a factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: SavingsApproval
classes.description: An immutable data holder for savings approval details such as approval date, locale, date format, and row index. Provides getter methods and a static factory method for import instances.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new SavingsApproval instance with specified approval date, row index, locale, and date format.

methods.name: getApprovedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the savings were approved.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale associated with the approval.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the date format string used.

methods.name: getRowIndex
methods.description: Returns the row index related to this approval.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note, which is an empty string in this implementation.
